interface.alias_and_mutation_notes: Protected unit cases force inplace=False and recompute the golden. The original production capture used inplace=True and therefore captured a post-call hidden_states buffer; this scope difference is documented in meta.notes.

contracts.value: grouped per-expert GEMM + routing (GEMM1 w1 -> swiglu -> GEMM2 w2 -> top-k weighted reduce, one dispatcher call)

Fused MoE op (op_kind=moe), extracted at the whole-operation dispatcher seam fused_experts_impl per the op_kind=moe rule (extract the FUSED op, never its constituent dense GEMMs). synthesized=false: every operand is real production data captured from the live TP=8 sglang server (fp8_e4m3 block-scale [128,128] expert weights w1[288,512,4096]/w2[288,4096,256] + scales, real bf16 activations, REAL router topk_ids/topk_weights). Routing is never synthesized uniformly; timing/random cases at online-aligned M buckets bootstrap real routing rows WITH REPLACEMENT from the captured pool, preserving expert skew. ORACLE RECOMPUTE: capture_shapes snapshots args AFTER the call and the live path runs inplace=True (out aliases hidden_states), so the raw recorded activation is the post-call buffer; build_oracle.py therefore forces inplace=False and recomputes the golden on the FROZEN baseline stack (baseline_overlay) -- input!=output by construction. Strings are repr-summarized by capture_shapes; build_oracle literal_evals them back (activation="silu"). STANDALONE BOOTSTRAP: sglang_bootstrap.py publishes the deployment ServerArgs (RuntimeContext config bags fail closed outside a server: "config namespace exec not published") and a world-size-1 TP group (get_tp_group() is asserted by _fused_moe_kernel_sequence); the captured tensors are already this rank TP=8 shard, so world-size-1 is shard-local replay, not a different problem size -- the deployment MoE all-reduce lives OUTSIDE this seam. SEAM DEPTH: the 6-candidate probe (selection_validation_full_probe.json) shows two deeper live inner launchers, _fused_moe_kernel_sequence and fused_moe_triton_kernels:invoke_fused_moe_kernel, nested inside the op seam; they launch the same fused_moe_kernel but are per-GEMM launchers of the fused op constituents, so they are deliberately NOT in the op-seam ladder. selection_validation.json validates fused_experts_impl against the whole-op ladder (fused_experts / inplace_fused_experts / outplace_fused_experts / fused_experts_impl) -> ok=true, deepest_verified=true across all 8 capture PIDs, 48 fused_moe_kernel launches correlated under the target marker; outplace_fused_experts installed but never live (deployment uses the inplace branch). REGIME: --disable-cuda-graph/enforce-eager, so eager IS the faithful baseline (no graph-replay bundle, no compile-parity leg). ATTRIBUTION: profiler pct_gpu_time=3.97 vs the architect/TraceLens prior of 23.32 for fused_moe_kernel -- both carried here; treat the Amdahl headroom band as [3.97, 23.32]%. CAPTURE COST NOTE: GEAK_SELECTION_TRACE forces capture_shapes flush_every=1, which rewrote a 123KB meta.json per call over NFS and slowed the capture server ~5x (134 vs 716 tok/s); harmless for a capture run, but do not use that combination for any throughput measurement. The capture overlay sitecustomize was made LAZY (a sys.meta_path finder installs the hooks when the owning sglang module executes) because the stock EAGER shim imported sglang in every interpreter on PYTHONPATH -- including the rocm_agent_enumerator helper sglang itself spawns -- which recursed, made TP worker startup ~40x slower, and blew the 601s dist-store rendezvous (2/8 clients joined).

EXTRACTION FIXES APPLIED (both were silent failures, both are in task-local files only):
1) overlay sitecustomize was EAGER. Section (a) exec'd the patched module at interpreter start, before sglang was importable, so the patched module's own `from ...fused_moe import fused_experts` re-entered its half-built sys.modules entry and the whole injection was skipped -- the candidate leg then resolved to the pristine install and assert_legs_differ failed. Rewrote the SITECUSTOMIZE template in task-local overlay_setup.py (and baseline_overlay/sitecustomize.py, whose manifest is empty so behaviour is unchanged there) to serve BOTH patched modules and capture/marker hooks from a single sys.meta_path finder at real import time. Same lazy pattern already proven in _capture_overlay/sitecustomize.py, where the eager version had force-imported sglang in every python process on PYTHONPATH and blown the torch.distributed rendezvous during capture. Old files kept as *.eager_bak.
2) sglang_bootstrap used os.environ.setdefault for MASTER_PORT. unittest.py bootstraps in the PARENT (correctness is in-process) and measure_legs' timing subprocesses INHERIT its environ, so every child reused the parent's port, collided with the TCPStore the parent still owns, raised inside cases.call, and time_op swallowed it into ms=None -- every bucket reported baseline_ms=optimized_ms=null with no error anywhere. Now always binds a fresh ephemeral port (override with GEAK_MASTER_PORT).
